pieces.Text: A secret broker can expend 1 point of mental focus from her divination implement in order to erase a fact from someone's mind by touch. This works similarly to modify memory to erase the memory of an event, except the effect is instantaneous and leaves no magical trace (it can still be removed by break enchantment, psychic surgery, limited wish, miracle, or wish) and the secret broker can remove only one fact, such as "The queen and the general are having an affair" rather than a 5-minute event. Erasing the memory of a fact does not prevent the target from learning the fact again, or even potentially from deducing the fact again from evidence, given time.
